title: Amazing Polish Pork Dumplings
description: Indulgent Polish dish featuring shiso-leaf and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a hearty dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large mixing bowl combine ground pork, chopped shiso leaves, chopped ferment kimchi, crumbly farmer cheese, beaten egg, almond flour, salt, and black pepper
Mix all the ingredients together until just combined, being careful not to overmix
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small dumplings, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, or until cooked through
While the dumplings are baking, melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat
Once the dumplings are done, remove them from the oven and add them to the skillet with the melted butter
Toss the dumplings in the butter to coat, then serve hot
